comment: Blocked runtime-evidence recipe for mhitm.c:passivemm’s AD_ACID branch and its trap.c:acid_damage call. Level-30 Conflict setup brings a hostile dwarf with a pick-axe into melee with a hostile acid blob. The C recording reaches passivemm’s successful acid_damage gate at step 135 and corrodes the pick-axe at step 137. JavaScript stops at step 132 in mhitm.c:mattackm’s unported armed monster-vs-monster AT_WEAP path, before passivemm runs; the recipe does not establish matching passivemm evidence until mattackm and weapon.c:possibly_unwield are implemented.
